about_the_game:
Run, jump, and dash through abandoned factories, overgrown greenhouses, and dangerous chemical warehouses. Surge Runner is easy to pick up, but hard to master. Try to beat levels quickly and overcome your personal high score. Compete for a top spot in the global leaderboards, and prove yourself as a Surge Runner Master!

This demo contains the first three stages for Surge Runner.

Collecting powerups increases your movement speed. The more you collect the faster you can complete the stage. But beware, controlling your momentum becomes harder at high speeds!

When you complete a level, your score is entered into the leaderboards. Try to beat your personal best. Or if you're feeling really ambitious, compete for the top spot globally!

In addition to just going fast, there are numerous trials to overcome. Whether it's beating a level faster than the developers, or collecting as many powerups as possible in one run, Challenges offer new ways to play!
